Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Tekz Bard Helper
Description:
Play MIDI files on any instrument (playlist, track on/off and transpose, speed, ensemble start), and run a band: the party leader clicks Host and posts an invite, members press Join, and the leader can then play songs for everyone, switch the whole band - or one member - to any instrument, hand out which member plays which track, send a song file to anyone who lacks it, and stand the band in a ready-made shape for 3, 4, 6 or 8 players - or one you draw yourself - and turn them to face the right way.

Security: the leader's plugin hosts the connection directly - no outside server. Joining needs the invite's secret code, the host only admits people in its party, and members only obey commands while the host is their current party leader. Moving a member's character is off unless that member turns it on. All traffic is encrypted.

Hosting needs members to reach the leader's PC: same network works out of the box; across the internet, forward the shown port. Formations use the vnavmesh plugin.

Use /tbh to open it.
Punchline: All-in-one bard: play MIDI files, run your party's band, switch instruments and set formations.

Author: Anmi (fork maintained by T3chnicalD3ath Inc.)
Name: Beast Master Helper
Description:
Tracks the Beastmaster quest chain and beast-catalogue collection progress, auto-recording captures from chat and offering navigation to quest and catalogue targets. Works with vnavmesh for same-map travel and Lifestream for cross-map teleports.

An English fork of Anmi's Beastmaster plugin.
Punchline: Track Beastmaster job progress and your beast catalogue.

Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Reaction Helper
Description: Load a fight timeline (cactbot format) or a per-job profile, and attach reactions to mechanics: conditions on you, your target and your party, and actions that press a skill, flip a MachinistHelper or BeastMasterHelper toggle, hold an action, or show an alert.
Punchline: Timeline and job reactions that drive your rotation plugins.

Author: The Combat Reborn Team (fork maintained by t3knical)
Name: BossmodReborn (Tekz Fork)
Description:
UNOFFICIAL FORK of BossMod Reborn by the Combat Reborn Team - install the original from their own repository if you want the real thing (https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/BossmodReborn).

This build tracks upstream and adds extra work on the Occult Crescent critical engagements and FATEs, and on the Beastmaster Crucible of the Unbroken boards, tuned against recorded replays. Bugs here are this fork's, not upstream's - report them at https://github.com/t3knical/DalamudPlugins rather than to the Combat Reborn Team.
Punchline: Unofficial Tekz fork of BossMod Reborn

Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Party Monitor
Description:
Monitors your party and reports changes. Tracks members joining and leaving, can look up encounter logs, and optionally relays party activity to a Discord channel.

Discord and FFLogs integration are optional and require you to supply your own credentials in the plugin settings. No credentials are bundled with the plugin.

Author: OhKannaDuh (fork maintained by T3chnicalD3ath)
Name: Occult Helper
Description:
OccultHelper is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: occulthelper (alias: och)
  /occulthelper → Opens the main window
  /occulthelper config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /occulthelper config list → Lists config keys
  /occulthelper config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /occulthelper config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /occulthelper buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /occulthelper tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /occulthelper illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /occulthelper reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /occulthelper (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)
Punchline: OccultHelper is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Hunter
Description:
Automatically hunts mobs to collect specific items. Teleports to the right zone, mounts and flies to spawn points, engages and chains kills, tracks inventory progress live, and returns home when every enabled item is complete.

Organise items into hunt lists, import ingredient lists from Artisan (only ingredients that drop from mobs in the database are added), and edit the mob database in game.

Requires vnavmesh, Rotation Solver Reborn and Lifestream.
Punchline: Automatically hunt mobs for specific items

Author: karashiiro (fork maintained by T3chnicalD3ath Inc.)
Name: PingWatcher
Description:
Displays your connection latency in the server info bar, with an optional graph and monitor window.

This build adds address detection that works under Linux/Wine, where the standard client-state method does not resolve the game server address.

An unofficial fork of PingPlugin by karashiiro, redistributed under the MIT License. All original credit goes to karashiiro.

Original project: https://github.com/karashiiro/PingPlugin
Changelog: Rebranded as PingWatcher and rebuilt for the current Dalamud API level.

Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Party Recruitment Helper
Description: A plugin that helps manage Party Finder recruitment configurations. Save preset slot layouts and automatically reapply them when party members leave, eliminating the need to manually reconfigure slots repeatedly.
Punchline: Save and auto-restore Party Finder slot configurations
